title: Proportion of Resale HDB Flats Transacted with Cash-Over-Valuation (COV) and Quantum of COVs
what_it_is: Proportion of Resale HDB Flats Transacted with Cash-Over-Valuation (COV) and Quantum of COVs

sections.label: CPF Housing Grant increases
sections.summary: Eligible First-Timer families and singles buying resale flats receive increased CPF Housing Grants, with higher amounts for 2-room to 4-room flats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Eligible First-Timer families buying a 2-room to 4-room resale flat can receive $80,000 in CPF Housing Grant, up from $50,000 previously, while those buying a 5-room or larger resale flat can receive $50,000 in CPF Housing Grant, up from $40,000 previously.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Eligible First-Timer singles buying a 2-room to 4-room resale flat can similarly receive an increased CPF Housing Grant of $40,000, up from $25,000 previously; while those buying a 5-room resale flat can receive $25,000, up from $20,000 previously.

sections.label: Resale flat COV trends
sections.summary: After the February 2023 CPF Housing Grant enhancement, about 18% of resale flat buyers paid COV, down from 29% in 2022 and 36% in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: After the CPF Housing Grant was enhanced in February 2023, about 18% resale flat buyers paid COV.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This is a noticeable reduction from about 29% in 2022 and 36% in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The majority of resale flat buyers did not have to pay any COV and the median COV across all buyers has remained at $0.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: COV restrictions would be challenging to enforce, as buyers and sellers could collude to circumvent the restrictions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to keep a close watch on the affordability of flats on the resale market.

sections.label: Residents choosing locations for caregiving
sections.summary: First-timer residents chose certain locations for needs such as caregiving to family members living in the same block or nearby.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I have residents telling me, first-timer residents telling me they chose certain locations because of certain needs, for example, caregiving needs to family members living in the same block or nearby.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I think it is sensible to not over-complicate the scheme and overly intervene in such decisions.
